description: Keep a tmux session of named windows running: start, stop, restart and list them
author: Serg Parf and agent-bus contributors

start.help: Start missing configured windows after observing live panes; present names answer already running.

stop.help: Send SIGTERM to selected configured windows’ process groups, allow 10s to save, then close them.

restart.help: Stop then start selected configured windows with the same liveness checks.

list.help: Show every configured window’s real presence, pane liveness, pid, uptime and cwd; mark extra windows unmanaged.

status.help: Status ask from real tmux checks: ok when all configured windows are alive, degraded when some are up, failed when none are up or the session is absent.

help.help: Describe calls and Configuration; every method is available to callers admitted by the record ACL, with no extra role or Owner checks.

session.help: One tmux session name: 1..32 letters, digits, - or _. Default: instance component of this agent name, or tmux-sessions for the main record.

windows.help: Up to32 objects: required name (unique tmux window name,1..32 letters/digits/-/_), cwd (existing absolute directory), command (non-empty /bin/sh -c string,max4096 bytes,no NUL/newline), optional env (object or the shared env-file text). Base env is stripped; person’s manager PATH is applied, then env overrides it. At most64 env keys,max4096 bytes/value; AGENT_BUS_TOKEN and AB_ROLE_* are refused. Only Owner/Maintainers write Configuration. No runtime, args, tags, window or bus-name keys.
Optional configured window names; none means all configured windows. Unknown names fail before any action.
